contentBlocks.text: Your Independent Guide to SASSA Social Grants

SASSA (South African Social Security Agency) provides monthly social grants to millions of South Africans. This independent resource helps you understand each grant, check your eligibility, find payment dates, apply online, and appeal if your application is declined. We are not affiliated with SASSA or any government department — we simply make the information easier to find and use.

South Africa's social grant system is one of the most extensive in the developing world. SASSA administers grants ranging from the Older Person Grant (state pension) to the Child Support Grant and the Social Relief of Distress (SRD R370) grant. Each grant has specific eligibility criteria based on age, income, and personal circumstances. The application process varies by grant type — some can be completed entirely online (like the SRD grant), while others require a visit to your local SASSA office.

Official SASSA information can be difficult to navigate — websites go down during peak periods, application statuses are confusing, and the appeals process is not well documented elsewhere. This site was created to fill that gap. Every page is written in plain language, updated when grant amounts or rules change, and designed to help you get the support you are entitled to. All factual claims about grant amounts and eligibility are sourced from official SASSA publications and Government Gazettes.

contentBlocks.title: Important Disclaimer
contentBlocks.text: This is an independent informational resource. We are not affiliated with SASSA, the South African government, or any official agency. For official applications, status checks, and appeals, always use the official SASSA website at sassa.gov.za or call 0800 60 10 11. Our guides are researched and written to help you understand the system — they are not a substitute for official processes.
